response.sql: WITH grp AS (SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_amount FROM `order` o JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE o.amount > 2802 GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM grp) SELECT g.account_id, g.region, g.avg_amount, g.avg_amount - overall.overall_avg AS difference FROM grp g CROSS JOIN overall ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The filter amount > 2802 applies to individual order rows before grouping, not to the group averages. Inner joins to account and district drop orders without a matching account or district, as the request asks. The overall figure is the simple average of the per-(account, region) averages.
